main_text.head: SECT. XVIII. De multiprœsentia Corporis Christi.
main_text.p: ISTud vero ἐπιφανὴς μυστήριον edidit certè illa altera, quæ de πολλαχοῦ Christi corporis fabula est, & in scenam produxit: nec scio vtri primas deferam fatuitatis, fraudisque sophisticæ: Vt nulle in locis subluna-ris huiusce mundi sit idem Christi corpus, quod tamen interea totum in cœlis est; Vt integrum corpus Christi in minutâ quadam placentulâ ita delitescat, membra vt se non penetrent, sed distincta, & inter se disposità sint, habeantq; figuram
main_text.notes: Greek words in the text are only approximated; the margin notes on the left are too faint and damaged to read. Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored. The first line of the body is a drop-cap I joined to "Stud".
